expect.outcome: Return an evidence-based comparison of causes of conflicting workshop booking expectations.

authority.source: Coordinator mandate R-01; selected de-identified booking and maintenance records.

acceptance: Each causal claim names a supplied source or a missing observation; no invented interviews or benefits.

stop_conditions: Required authority or source evidence is missing.
Declared budget is spent or a proposed edit crosses protected scope.
One investigation pass produces no supported next observation.

checks.expected: Source-to-claim audit; compare chronology predictions; check that no operational action occurred.

decide.object: The discovery report and its proposed next observation, not a booking service.
